text: Bapco Energies, Bahrain's national energy holding company, is fully owned by the government of the Kingdom of Bahrain.
short: Bapco Energies is fully owned by the Bahraini government

source.name: Bapco Energies — Investors
source.quote: Bapco Energies is fully owned by the Kingdom of Bahrain's government, and reports directly to The Higher Committee for Energy and Natural Resources.

additionalSources.name: Gulf Daily News (GDN Online) — Bahrain expected to issue $2-3 billion of international bonds in 2025
additionalSources.quote: This follows a $1bn sukuk issued by state-owned Bapco Energies earlier this month.
